headline: King John Yields to Barons, Seals Great Charter of Liberties at Runnymede
dispatch: King John of England set his seal to the Magna Carta at Runnymede yesterday, conceding sweeping limits on royal power after months of armed revolt by the kingdom's barons. The charter sets out rights of freemen and restricts the crown's ability to levy taxes or imprison subjects without lawful judgment. Copies are to be sent to every English county.
answer: King John seals Magna Carta at Runnymede, 1215
